about_the_game:
Unique battle system | Enter commands in rhythm and activate skills. Play a clever beat according to the combination of cards in your hand and your opponent's attacks.

Variety of stages | Fight on stages with different BGMs, from the city to ruins. The playing experience changes depending on the tempo and beat of the music.

Customize your deck | Create your own deck by freely combining skills and gifts received from existing characters. Let's find the strongest combination.

Endurance mode | Aim for consecutive battles while reinforcing your skills and obtaining gifts. Unleash a powerful attack with new skills.

Lots of character | Muzzles, wings, fins...fun and cheerful companions are waiting for you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB RAM, OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: CENTO is a game where you enter commands in time with music and activate skills to fight. Collect gifts while reinforcing your skills and fight on stages with a wide variety of songs!
